summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd, via its subsidiaries, publicly listed certain long-aged accounts receivable and one prepaid account on the Beijing Equity Exchange for potential transfer. The assets had a book value of RMB226 million (~US$33.4 million) but were appraised at RMB8.56 million (~US$1.26 million) as of April 30, 2026, with initial transfer floors totaling RMB8.56 million. The process is preliminary, with no purchaser selected and no definitive agreements executed. This is a routine disclosure of a potential asset disposal by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation requiring classification under the specified categories.
